endorsements.quote: Similarly, there are lessons to be learnt from healthcare improvement methodologies including Lean, Six Sigma and PDSA [ 28 – 30 ].
However, at least a proportion of patients would expect to be informed of the presence of AI in the delivery of their care and discovering this retrospectively may impact trust.
Patient stakeholders have different perspectives that can add value to both the identification and prioritization of healthcare research to which we want to apply AI [ 13 ].

The inclusion of patients in any criteria development for accessing new technologies and in evaluating AI in clinical settings, including identifying criteria for granting patient access to new AI technologies and reflecting their interests in AI metrics, was also highlighted in the EPF report.
There are increasingly calls for these insights to be recognised and compensated, with the US National Institute of Health (NIH) National Health Council Fair Market Value calculator [ 15 ].
As much as possible, these clinician insights should be incorporated earlier in the development and integration of AI tools to allow for more intentional pursuit of patient values.

unlisted_practices: Involve clinicians early in the design, translation and integration of AI tools and care pathways.
Scale AI-specific training and workforce development for healthcare professionals.
Create succinct KPI-driven metrics to measure the effectiveness of patient engagement strategies.
Evaluate AI implementation outcomes such as acceptability at multiple stages of implementation.
Combine patient-centric and product-centric approaches in AI product development, engaging patients beyond usability testing.
Prioritise involvement of communities experiencing health inequality, non-native speakers, and those with low education or socioeconomic status in AI research.
Monitor and appropriately evaluate clinician interventions that alter AI use to ensure they rest on adequate understanding of the tool.

screen.reason: Commentary providing recommendations on how to integrate patient perspectives into AI deployment, development, and implementation in healthcare.
